label: D1 after unrewarded a1->S2 rare, ramping with episode trial >60; larger if trial before rewarded
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * np.clip(ep_trial - 60, 0, 40) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * np.clip(ep_trial - 80, 0, 20) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * np.clip(ep_trial - 60, 0, 40) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * np.clip(ep_trial - 60, 0, 40) * (tv("reward", -2) == -9) ;; (phase == D1) * (trial == 0) * (in_rew == 0) * np.clip(ep_trial - 60, 0, 40)
explanation: Active only at D1. Magnitude is an interaction of the previous trial being a1 -> S2 (rare) unrewarded with episode time: near zero before trial ~60, then rising steeply (piecewise linear in ep_trial, steeper after 80) to ~1.0-1.2 late. Additive tables cap at 0.15 (last trial alone 0.13) because the effect is multiplicative with time. Within a1 S2 u, it is much larger when the trial before was rewarded (a lone surprise loss); after consecutive losses it is weak. When the earlier history is outside the window it also behaves as high (window-edge term), and on the window first trial an unrewarded D1 late in episode fires too (history unknown). Choice/policy, value, hidden good state and trials-since-reversal add nothing (value or choice interactions +0.000). GO and D2: always zero. Test R2 beyond timing 0.62 (dev 0.63), far above the additive all ceiling 0.15. Only observed variables used.

issues: Claims hold up. The profile shows activity only at D1 (GO and D2 residuals are all +0). The D1 residual by previous trial is +0.117 for a1 S2 u and between -0.01 and -0.013 for every other pattern. Timing is about zero before decile 6 and rises in deciles 7-9. Test R^2 beyond timing reproduces at 0.6236.

The 'lone loss' claim is confirmed. Weights: base -0.002/trial, after trial 80 +0.015, when the trial before was rewarded +0.021. At trial ~95 that predicts about 0.97 after a rewarded trial versus about 0.19 after back-to-back losses.

The window-edge handling is lossy. The tv('reward',-2)==-9 term mixes rewarded and unrewarded histories: in the dev window [t93 r0 ... t94], prediction 0.72 vs actual 0.16. tv('prev_reward',-1)==1 (the reward input seen at the previous D1, which is observed) replaces both tv('reward',-2) terms and does better: test 0.653 vs 0.624.

The largest remaining systematic miss is D1 of the window's first trial late in the episode with in_rew=0. Actual is about 1.2, the edge term predicts 0.17-0.45, and these make up most of the worst-fit windows. Here the previous trial is outside the window. Multiplying the edge term by the model's D1 policy logit (clip(choice,0)) lifts test to 0.707. The upcoming-choice version (future, action==1) gives 0.692. This is a window artefact rather than a wrong description of the feature.

Small leftover: some a1 S2 u trials late in the episode, where the trial before was rewarded, still sit near 0. Example: t95 after S2R, S2R: predicted 0.93, actual 0. Adding a term for a rare transition on the trial before (prev_common -1 == 0) helps only slightly (+0.003).
